plain: Having the model always pick its single most likely next word, so the same prompt always gives the same answer.
eli5: Always taking the biggest cookie on the plate, so you know exactly which one you will get.
technical: Decoding that takes the argmax token at every step (temperature 0, no sampling), so the output is deterministic up to numerical noise; HarmBench uses it so that an attack success rate has no sampling variance.
